# Project Phoenix v49.0 Rules Hub on_actions (100% additive).
# Generated by gen_v490_game_rules_hub.py; edit the generator, not this file.

on_game_start = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_v49_hub_on_game_start
	}
}

on_game_started_after_lobby = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_v49_hub_on_after_lobby
	}
}

# Sync lobby game rules immediately on campaign initialization and queue Day-2 Hub if a human realm is present.
oe_v49_hub_on_game_start = {
	effect = {
		oe_v49_hub_sync_game_rules_effect = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_shown } }
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
					is_rebel_country = no
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_hub_shown value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_v49_hub.1 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Fallback right after leaving the lobby (ensures singleplayer human player receives Day-2 Hub once, never in observer mode).
oe_v49_hub_on_after_lobby = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_hub_shown } }
			oe_v49_hub_reset_to_lobby_effect = yes
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = no
					is_rebel_country = no
				}
				set_global_variable = { name = oe_v49_hub_shown value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_v49_hub.1 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
